agent_context_notes._research_context_russian_neerc: COMMON CONTEXT for all central-russia/north-russia/south-russia/far-east-russia/west-neerc/west-siberia entries below. Confirmed 1998-2002 season organizer/host per subregion (from an official NEERC organizers' 2001-2002 season paper by Vasilev/Kazakov/Korneev/Parfenov/Stankevich, https://www.kgeorgiy.info/papers/Vasilev_VN__Kazakov_MA__Korneev_GA__Parfenov_VG__Stankevich_AS_--_NEERC_2001.pdf): Central=Rybinsk State Aviation Technological Academy (RGATA); Northwestern/North=SPbGITMO (predecessor of ITMO, i.e. the SAME organization that runs neerc.ifmo.ru today); Southern/South-Volga=Saratov State University (SGU); Far Eastern=Far Eastern State University (DVGU, Vladivostok); West Siberian=Novosibirsk State Technical University (NSTU/NGTU); Western/Belarus=Belarusian State University (BSU). NEERC finals that season: 301 teams from 148 universities, held 24-29 Nov 2001 in St. Petersburg (Anichkov Palace) - this is aggregate/semifinal info only, not per-subregion quarterfinal standings. EXHAUSTIVELY CHECKED and confirmed BLANK for all 6 subregions, years 1998-2002: the organizer's own current archive at neerc.ifmo.ru/subregions/{central,northern,southern,far-eastern,west-siberian,western}.html lists 1998-2002 as bare section headers with zero links/text of any kind (verified by direct raw-text extraction, not just absence of hyperlinks) - the templated per-year archive (pattern https://neerc.ifmo.ru/archive/[YEAR]/[subregion]/standings.html) only starts populating from 2003 onward for every single subregion. By contrast the NEERC FINALS/semifinal archive (https://neerc.ifmo.ru/archive/[YEAR].html and .../archive/[YEAR]/standings.html) DOES go back to 1998 with real content - confirming the gap is specific to subregional/quarterfinal-level results, not the whole organization's archive. Separately, acm.timus.ru (Ural State University's judge, unaffiliated with the above 6 host institutions except informally) independently mirrors NEERC quarterfinal problem sets under a 'qf' tag (https://acm.timus.ru/problemset.aspx?space=1&tag=qf) but that mirror covers ONLY the Central, Northern, and 'Eastern'(Ural/Ekaterinburg, not one of our 6 targets) subregions, and even then only Central goes back as far as 2000 - Southern, Far Eastern, West Siberian and Western/Belarus have ZERO presence on Timus in any year. contest.sgu.ru (South-Russia/Saratov's own current platform) was checked directly (pre-approved domain) and its 'Прошлые соревнования'/'Архив' sections only go back to 2010. Given both the organizing university side (ifmo.ru) and the regional host side (sgu.ru) independently confirm nothing survives from this era, and Timus's incidental mirror doesn't reach 4 of the 6 subregions at all, these look like genuinely lost/never-digitized results rather than merely hard-to-find ones - most were run on paper/local scoring in an era before these subregions had dedicated websites. A future pass with web.archive.org access (blocked this session) checking the *.narod.ru / early *.edu.ru personal-page era, plus direct outreach to RGATA/DVGU/NSTU/BSU archives, is the most promising remaining avenue.
